rules.common_support: Global intersection for candidates/ranks, all pair metrics and matching evidence; empty support cannot establish a match
rules.omitted_mass: unobserved_mass is posterior mass outside the declared comparison support; it may include variants observed in an individual pair but excluded from the global intersection
rules.source_component_metadata: CS sizes, purity, representatives and entropy resolution describe original fits, without redefining their formal CS
rules.matching: CS-to-CS: overlap OR CS overlap OR representative LD; CS-to-unretained: posterior overlap only, unresolved
rules.component_layer: All active components plus formal CS boundary cases; diffuse overlap is descriptive, not a confirmed split/merge
rules.resolution: Continuous entropy effective-candidate count and fraction; no calibrated binary diffuse threshold
rules.candidates: Union of formal CS members, requested top candidates and PIP-threshold candidates
rules.display: Baseline first; greedy one-to-one formal-CS aid is not evidence of unique signal identity

limitations: PIP across settings is not averaged into a posterior.
CS count and matching relations do not identify an independent causal signal count.
Genotype correlation alone does not establish that two effects are conditionally indistinguishable.

definitions.alpha: conditional selection probability within one component
definitions.pip: marginal inclusion probability across active components
definitions.effective_candidates: entropy-based resolution of normalized biological alpha; not a causal count
definitions.cs_count: number of retained component credible sets, not number of independent causal signals
definitions.prior_influence: conditional BF depends on other components/settings; ordinary SER uses pi + sqrt(machine epsilon), including nominal zero pi; hard-exclusion proposals retain exact zeros. Raw and effective prior odds are distinct. Trimmed V=0 rows are prior state, not SER evidence.
